title: Next-Period Coverage with a Good-Standing Payment and the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Rule.** Where the AutoPay on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement cannot be relied on for the next due date, the good-standing amount also collects part of the next billing period, held on the agreement as a credit balance toward that rent. The next-period coverage follows the agreement's Bluegate AutoPay Authorization:

- where the authorization is in **active** status and its latest draft attempt was **declined because the card on file has expired**, **1** month is covered;
- where the authorization is **suspended** and the agreement carries **2 or more** late fees posted in the 12 months up to the handling date, **2** months are covered;
- otherwise no month is covered.

The coverage is the covered months multiplied by the price of the covered month, rounded to the cent, half up, once, and the good-standing amount is the balance due plus that coverage, rounded to the cent.

The authorization's status and the result of its latest draft attempt are read from the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization record drafting this agreement and its draft history; the late fees are the late-fee entries on the agreement's ledger posted within the 12 months up to the handling date.

## Combinations

| Authorization status | Latest draft result | Late fees in 12 months | Months covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | declined, card on file expired | any | 1 |
| active | any other result | any | 0 |
| suspended | — | 2 or more | 2 |
| suspended | — | 0 or 1 | 0 |
| cancelled, or no authorization | — | any | 0 |

## Hypothetical figures
A suspended authorization and 3 late fees in the 12 months: two covered months, each priced as the covered month, held toward the next rent. An active authorization whose latest draft was approved: no month covered.
